summary: Georgia tower list places candler in Candler County with elevation 221 and codes BLL-64689 and gfc-109; no other source found on its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: List row for candler: coordinates, Candler County, elevation column 221, codes BLL-64689 and gfc-109 and the word usgs
List says names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: The list's Google map is marked as revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list supports this record. Two WebSearch queries (Candler County and Metter fire tower history) found no source on this tower. The Eastern U.S. Lookouts page at candler.html describes a 100-foot steel tower in Marion County, under a Florida-style listing; it is a different tower and was not used. The codes BLL-64689 and gfc-109 and the word usgs are reported as they appear in the list; their meaning was not established. The list gives elevation with no unit. The story is about 95 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no second source was found. Nothing found describes the site today or public access. No photos.
